Definition: from the same as G2165; joyfulness:--gladness, joy.
BiblicalUsage: The word euphrosýnē carries the sense of gladness, joy. In Acts 2:28, the text says "thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance."
TheologicalSignificance: I take euphrosýnē as it stands: gladness, joy.
